entries.detail: Release notes stay current without anyone writing them by hand, so each update is documented as soon as it lands.
entries.title: Changelog entries are now generated automatically on every merge

entries.detail: Review the exact package version and source before installing; a changed source must be reviewed again, and installs run with a clean, whitelisted environment.
entries.title: Add project MCP servers from npm and PyPI with reviewed installs
test(e2e): the window cap counts sessions and live sockets, not reconnects
test(ci): e2e_slot_run's nice check is relative to the caller's niceness

entries.detail: Archiving now stops all running work, and opening, sending, retrying or nudging an archived session is refused; the composer shows it is archived and unarchive restores it without starting anything.
entries.title: Archived sessions now stay frozen until you unarchive them

entries.detail: Both pages now include the same sidebar as the rest of the Library, so you can navigate between sections without losing your place.
entries.title: Skills and Automations pages now show the Library sidebar

entries.detail: Pasting into the terminal no longer races ahead of the agent, so pasted text arrives in order and is not dropped.
entries.title: Pasted terminal input is held until the agent has processed it

entries.detail: Each session now shows as a unit card with status sectors, grouped by project, and session windows open in their own layer above the map.
entries.title: Sessions map redesigned with a tactical strip, unit cards and floating windows

entries.detail: Each agent account can now run against its own home overlay, and BattleLab verifies the setup is healthy before sessions start.
entries.title: Agent accounts get isolated home directories with a built-in health check

entries.detail: Target an API session for starting a session or sending a message; unsafe or non-idle targets are refused, and API targets never bypass permission prompts.
entries.title: Automations can now start and message API-backed agent sessions

entries.detail: The shell now stays inside the viewport on small screens, and footer text clips instead of running under the update chip.
entries.title: Page no longer overflows on narrow screens when the session list is closed

entries.detail: The terminal reads its visible area once per frame, and map windows no longer re-render while you pan, so both feel smoother.
entries.title: Terminal output and map panning now update more smoothly with less redraw work

entries.detail: Ask HQ to draft a playbook, skill or automation and it writes it straight into your library; the editor's non-working AI button has been removed.
entries.title: HQ can now write playbooks, skills and automations for you

entries.detail: See at a glance which active agents have memory access, plus copyable instructions for agents that don't, so you can set them up.
entries.title: Memory page now shows which agents can use the memory tool
test(terminal): the paste-intake fake outlives the teardown's SIGTERM until its input is…

entries.detail: The project owns the starting folder, with clear messages when no default folder is set, and the skip-permissions row is easier to tap.
entries.title: New Session page now shows where your session will start

entries.detail: Ask by voice to set up a new automation or choose a project folder; new automations start switched off until you turn them on.
entries.title: Create automations and pick project folders by voice

entries.detail: The scheduled catalog refresh picked up both versions after their 72-hour cool-down; launch behaviour is unchanged, and Claude Code and Copilot CLI stay on their current versions.
entries.title: Codex 0.169.0 and Kimi 2.6.2 are now in the bundled agent catalog

entries.detail: The small initials square no longer pokes past the angled corner of the operator plate, and it keeps matching if the cut size changes.
entries.title: Operator tile's initials square now follows the plate's cut corner

entries.detail: The header uses the new design's mark at every width, and on touch tablets the session head folds into a single Actions menu so the facts keep their width.
entries.title: Top bar now matches the v5 design with the BattleLab logo and wordmark

entries.detail: New sessions started by the adopt engine are no longer dropped during reconciliation, and placeholder links now open correctly after a page reload.
entries.title: Terminal sessions stay in sync after reload and placeholder links resolve

entries.detail: Followed sessions appear as a single block with one row per session showing its newest state, instead of a new row for every change.
entries.title: HQ now shows each followed session once, updating in place

entries.detail: Opening an audio or video artifact now shows a player page, so it plays in Chrome instead of failing to load.
entries.title: Audio and video artifacts now play in the browser

entries.detail: If a steering verdict arrives just after a turn has answered, it is now treated as a new question instead of saying it dropped something that was never stopped.
entries.title: Late voice interjections no longer act on turns that already finished

entries.detail: The asset check now only flags real asset files, so a deploy is no longer blocked by page routes that happen to look similar.
entries.title: Deploy checks no longer mistake page routes for missing assets

entries.detail: Ask HQ to archive, rename, tag, move, review or delete sessions and projects; it proposes the action, you confirm, and it reports an honest outcome.
entries.title: HQ can now change sessions and projects after you confirm a card

entries.detail: A single pause switch controls both app and agent updates; catalog-managed agents update after each refresh, and you get a plain notice when the catalog expires.
entries.title: App and installed agents now update automatically by default

entries.detail: Updating a managed agent used to make every queued message to a running session fail; those messages now go through as expected.
entries.title: Queued messages to running sessions are no longer rejected after an agent update

entries.detail: The bundled catalog now points at newer upstream releases that had been public for at least three days; no launch settings changed.
entries.title: Agent catalog updated to latest Claude, Codex, Copilot, Gemini, Kimi and OpenCode

entries.detail: The guides now explain that motion is a per-device setting rather than a server toggle, and stale wording about the dashboard, timers and hidden canvas is gone.
entries.title: Documentation corrected for motion, telemetry and boot behaviour

entries.detail: At narrow sidebar widths the hint now truncates within its own space instead of painting over the Attach, Camera and Send buttons.
entries.title: Composer hint no longer overlaps the attach, camera and send buttons

entries.detail: HQ now prepares its reply as you speak and sends it after your chosen pause, so a longer pause no longer delays the answer.
entries.title: Voice calls answer sooner because HQ drafts while you pause

entries.detail: The generated theme files were missing Settings' light-mode values and the stage sweep animation; they are now emitted correctly.
entries.title: Page theme tokens now include Settings' light values and stage sweep

entries.detail: Each instance gets a pinned identity; operators pair with a one-time invite and a short code, and paired instances keep an authenticated, encrypted channel open. No session data is shared yet.
entries.title: Pair two BattleLab instances over an encrypted peer channel

entries.detail: Create clusters, see them as a tree in the sidebar with a cluster head, move sessions between clusters, and manage them all from a new Settings card.
entries.title: Organise sessions into clusters from the sidebar and Settings

entries.detail: Every top-bar control is now the same tile size, the operator's initials fill their tile, and the phone footer stays on a single line.
entries.title: Phone top bar controls line up as equal tiles and the footer fits on one line

entries.detail: The first words of a reply no longer wait behind a preview of the next sentence, so speech starts sooner on servers running a single voice model.
entries.title: Voice replies now speak their first sentence without waiting for the next one

entries.detail: Import a bundle only after its contents and limits are checked, with safe retries and per-item failures that leave existing content untouched.
entries.title: Share skills and playbooks as verified bundle files

entries.detail: You can now see how much of a mission's step budget is left and its floor, and pause, continue or stop a running mission from the board.
entries.title: Missions get a budget floor and a running board with pause, continue and stop

entries.detail: You can now keep a mission's objectives, step order, slots and role needs as an inert, versioned plan that never names a real project or carries values, and archive it instead of deleting.
entries.title: Save a mission's plan as a reusable, slot-only mission plan in the Library

entries.detail: Each agent launch gets a scoped way to fetch only its permitted secrets, and access is revoked immediately when permissions change or the launch ends.
entries.title: Agents can request secrets they are granted access to

entries.detail: When old turns are dropped by the history cap, their trailing agent output is removed too, so the top of the history stays clean.
entries.title: History no longer shows leftover agent output from evicted turns

entries.detail: The broker socket stays where it is so running agents keep their secrets, and clients that disconnect before a reply no longer show up as errors.
entries.title: Session scan no longer mistakes the secrets broker socket for a session

entries.detail: Projecting a session's state now folds plain background heartbeats as records arrive, so snapshot reads do less work while the output stays identical.
entries.title: Snapshots read background heartbeats once instead of re-reading them

entries.detail: Relays, answers, nudges and approved drafts arrive as one checked turn; unsafe sends are stopped, and API sessions never receive keystrokes.
entries.title: Mission sends now reach API sessions as guarded structured turns

entries.detail: Subagents that ask for permission no longer wait forever, running subagents appear in the background strip, and Send now keeps your message queued instead of cancelling them.
entries.title: opencode subagents no longer hang and show in the background strip

entries.detail: Templates and variables now travel in share bundles; every text value is checked against stored secrets, and any item that would leak one is refused and marked unavailable.
entries.title: Share bundles can now carry templates and variables, with secrets blocked

entries.detail: The avatar is inset one pixel on all sides and clipped at both chamfered corners, and the plate's grey hairline edge keeps its hover and open tints.
entries.title: Operator menu avatar now sits cleanly inside the plate edge at every width

entries.detail: Agent sign-in and verification no longer fail to launch on hosts with older systemd versions.
entries.title: Sign-in and verification now start on systems running systemd older than 254

entries.detail: When another operator shares a terminal session with your instance, you can open it and read its screen as text, alongside the other shared views.
entries.title: Watch a paired instance's shared terminal session as text

entries.detail: The old flying signal trails and square grid no longer paint underneath the hex backdrop, so the background looks as designed in both light and dark mode.
entries.title: Only one atmosphere now renders behind the app, with no stray trails or square grid

entries.detail: Fresh turns preload no memory text; explicit remember, corrections, citations and optional capture follow existing rules, with capture off by default.
entries.title: HQ gains durable memory and scoped search across notebooks
test(web): wait for the artifact viewer's title effect instead of reading it synchronously
Internal change

entries.detail: Uploading a profile picture no longer fails when BattleLab sits behind a strict edge firewall or is reached over the relay.
entries.title: Avatar uploads now work through the Home Free relay and past edge filters

entries.detail: Unattended launches verify readiness from the engine's own log, apply a per-run guarded agent, and refuse to start when permissions or configuration cannot be confirmed.
entries.title: OpenCode 2 now supports safe unattended agent runs

entries.detail: Pick a hosted provider, choose Auto or a specific model, and set a thinking level; nothing is sent to a provider until you acknowledge it for that provider and origin.
entries.title: Connect hosted AI providers like OpenAI, Gemini and OpenRouter in Settings

entries.detail: Automatic resize-jiggle repaint nudges are skipped for these engines, while real viewport resizes and the manual Repaint button still work.
entries.title: Stop extra terminal repaints for engines that repaint on resize

entries.detail: The bundled catalog and recipes now offer these newer upstream agent versions; launching works exactly as before, and other pending updates stay on hold until their cool-down ends.
entries.title: Agent catalog picks up Gemini 0.67.0 and Kimi 2.5.0

entries.detail: The first-run wizard lists every agent with its status and lets you install it inline, then preselects a ready API client for launch while terminal clients stay one tap away.
entries.title: Setup now installs agents and starts API sessions first

entries.detail: Ask HQ a research question and it hands off to a Researcher that searches the web, reads the sources, cross-checks them and returns an answer with citations.
entries.title: HQ can now start a Researcher specialist that searches, reads and cites sources

entries.detail: The dashboard forecast labels which quota window it applies to, so the pace reading is no longer ambiguous.
entries.title: Quota forecast now names the window it is judging

entries.detail: Earlier exchanges are replayed in full and older parts are summarised in the background, so HQ stays aware of the discussion without cutting it off.
entries.title: HQ now keeps the whole conversation in context when answering

entries.detail: When a newer bundled agent version exists it wins over an older signed release, and Update never offers a catalog version older than the installed one — it points you to roll back instead.
entries.title: Agent catalog now offers the newest version instead of an older signed one

entries.detail: The bundled catalog now offers GitHub Copilot CLI 1.0.107 and Kimi 2.5.2, with no change to how agents launch.
entries.title: Copilot CLI and Kimi agent recipes updated to newer upstream versions

entries.detail: API sessions show their tool calls in mission transcripts, get a mission shelf tool, recover cleanly after restarts, and automatic sends only resume live sessions.
entries.title: Missions can now supervise Claude API sessions end to end

entries.detail: Finished file changes are now released as they complete, so a turn with lots of edits no longer hits the pending limit and stops mid-run.
entries.title: Long Codex turns with many file edits no longer crash the worker

entries.detail: The new-session form appears as a modal on top of the session map instead of replacing it, so your open windows stay in place while you set up the next agent.
entries.title: Starting a new session now opens over the map, keeping your windows connected

entries.detail: The sign-in, one-time code, password, device-link, connect and share pages now match your chosen theme, and a failed connect names the failed step and offers Back and Retry.
entries.title: Sign-in, password, device link and connect pages now follow your BattleLab theme

entries.detail: The page was re-reading the same session data once for every note; it now reads it once per view, cutting load time from about 19 seconds to about 0.3 seconds.
entries.title: Memory page now loads in under a second instead of nearly 19 seconds
feat(landing): stacked, General Lupu's briefing comes first and the welcome follows

entries.detail: Each general uses a saved voice override or their own listed voice, falling back to the group voice; refresh the voice list in HQ call settings after adding new voices.
entries.title: HQ generals can now speak with their own individual voices

entries.detail: Each notification gets a brief summary from your selected HQ contact, grouped into bundles and shown in the bell and a new Dispatches view, without changing the notification itself.
entries.title: HQ now writes a short line for each notification and keeps a Dispatches view

entries.detail: Native API turns can now carry server-built authority tokens that the worker verifies before claiming the turn, but no production caller uses this yet, so behaviour is unchanged.
entries.title: Native turn authority plumbing lands, with no user-visible change yet

entries.detail: The catalog now ships the newer Codex release; starting and running agents works exactly as before.
entries.title: Bundled Codex agent updated to 0.167.2

entries.detail: Daily statements are now checked against a pinned publisher key, so you can trust they came from the expected source.
entries.title: Pin the publisher's freshness key so daily statements verify
feat(landing): General Lupu's briefing takes the hero's right column; her transmission…

entries.detail: When an offered update keeps the same version, the prompt no longer shows an identical version on both sides of the arrow.
entries.title: Same-version agent updates now say they change BattleLab's setup

entries.detail: Sessions open as soon as launch begins, and a failed start offers a clear retry or discard choice instead of leaving you waiting.
entries.title: Starting a session now opens its page immediately

entries.detail: Every transcription request was failing with an error caused by an incompatible audio library version; the bundled version is now pinned to one the speech engine supports.
entries.title: Local speech server can transcribe audio again

entries.detail: The mute and end controls no longer scroll away, calls start without captions, and HQ gives an unfinished sentence a moment before replying.
entries.title: Call controls stay in view and HQ waits when you trail off

entries.detail: The upload read timeout is no longer cancelled by request middleware, so slow uploads stop cleanly at the configured limit.
entries.title: Uploads now time out correctly instead of hanging or failing early

entries.detail: Operator messages now reach the agent while background tasks run, so Send now works on the agent's own turn without pressing Stop.
entries.title: Sending a message to a busy agent no longer waits for background tasks to finish

entries.detail: Typed or spoken, HQ now opens what you ask for on the browser that asked, full screen or as a map window, and the line under the answer says what actually happened.
entries.title: Ask HQ to open a session, mission, artifact or settings page on your screen

entries.detail: When no session or mission matches, Ask now says so instead of showing a weak candidate, and answers only cite matches grounded in your question.
entries.title: Ask no longer returns an unrelated mission when nothing matches your question

entries.detail: Settings now has a single HQ models page with separate rows for typed turns, question routing, calls and mission conversations, each falling back to its enclosing call or the shared default.
entries.title: Configure HQ model and thinking choices in one place

entries.detail: The setup instructions now list the scope the test probe actually requires, so following them produces a connector that passes instead of one that fails.
entries.title: Forgejo setup hint now names the scope the connection test needs

entries.detail: The preview quotes the assembler's actual picks, and the card turns stale instead of writing when the team differs at confirmation.
entries.title: Assemble card now shows the team that will actually be written

entries.detail: A session that returns to the list no longer sends another alert; only genuinely new activity, or a record that expired or was dropped, triggers one.
entries.title: Needs-you alerts push once per episode instead of on every re-entry
Internal change

entries.detail: When a turn fails, its question stays in the conversation history, so asking to try again actually retries that request instead of starting fresh.
entries.title: Retrying a failed turn now includes the original question

entries.detail: Operators can grant a paired instance read-only access to one API session; the grant ends on revoke, expiry, peer revoke or when the session is archived.
entries.title: Share an API session with a paired instance, view only

entries.detail: When you switch to another General in the same chat, the new contact answers as themselves instead of repeating the previous contact's name; with the contact switched off, it answers as HQ.
entries.title: Switching HQ contacts mid-conversation now answers under the right name

entries.detail: Set an objective's predecessors when applying a plan; forward references are refused, the order can't change later, and objectives read waiting until earlier ones are done.
entries.title: Objectives can now be ordered, with derived states following that order
fix(tests): voice folder-pick roots are unique per run, so concurrent runs don't collide

entries.detail: Say yes in your own words or language and the assistant decides whether it confirms the card on screen; if it can't tell, the card stays and it asks you to use the screen.
entries.title: Spoken confirmations of HQ cards now work in any wording or language

entries.detail: If the connection drops, the sign-in terminal now reconnects automatically, keeps its screen, and closing it ends the sign-in immediately.
entries.title: Plugin sign-in terminal reconnects after a dropped connection

entries.detail: Cards staged before this change still confirm as before, and an identical retry replays its original result instead of being rejected.
entries.title: Confirming a staged card now tells you when the team changed since staging
test(e2e): give memory's Agent access card test its own timeout budget

entries.detail: Relaunches re-reserve the same version, and any refusal, such as being at capacity, archived, or a changed skill, is reported with its reason and nothing starts.
entries.title: Start terminal sessions directly from a specialist, with its skills and a reserved slot
docs(app): the operating model, written down — docs/operating-model.md and a CLAUDE.md…

entries.detail: A specialist's notebook is scoped to a single project, switches on and off with that project's memory, and is never carried into another project's sessions.
entries.title: Specialists keep their own notes separately for each project

entries.detail: HQ now stays silent until it has the actual answer, while the on-screen status still updates as before.
entries.title: Voice calls no longer speak filler lines before answers

entries.detail: Opening HQ after a page load no longer reopens your latest conversation; kept conversations are one pick away in the switcher, and you can now delete a conversation.
entries.title: HQ opens on a fresh conversation, and conversations can be deleted

entries.detail: Portrait images are now built from the app's configured base path, so they display properly behind a relay instead of breaking.
entries.title: HQ portraits now load correctly when BattleLab is served from a subpath

entries.detail: The Send now action no longer drops off or wraps onto its own line, so it stays available alongside the rest of the composer controls.
entries.title: Send now always appears with the other composer buttons on one row

entries.detail: Every public page carries the same BattleLab bar, and a shared artifact opens beneath it; the bar collapses to a corner tab for the rest of the visit.
entries.title: Shared artifacts and public pages now show the BattleLab header
test(ask): a usage answer's stored-figures check ignores the record's own timestamp

entries.detail: Pick items to download as one bundle, then preview imports with dependency checks, rename or refusal reasons, and retry failed items without importing anything twice.
entries.title: Export and import skill and playbook bundles from the Library

entries.detail: Newer upstream versions of three agents are available out of the box, with no change to how they launch; Claude Code and Copilot CLI stay on their current versions.
entries.title: Bundled agent catalog now ships Codex 0.167.1, Gemini 0.68.0 and Kimi 2.5.3

entries.detail: If you talk during a running call, BattleLab quickly decides whether to respond now or ask you to wait, and your words are no longer held silently until the turn ends.
entries.title: Speaking while an agent is busy now gets an immediate reply instead of waiting silently

entries.detail: Agent steps in a playbook can require a role with skills and a minimum grade; roles are filled by a specialist when a mission is assembled.
entries.title: Playbook steps can now name a role instead of an engine or model

entries.detail: Previously an out-of-memory tool could take down the entire API session; now only that tool is stopped, so your other work keeps running.
entries.title: A tool that runs out of memory is now killed on its own, not the whole session

entries.detail: When the local speech server reports an unsupported language, BattleLab now surfaces that error instead of retrying without the language, which could mispronounce text or switch to plain output.
entries.title: Voice synthesis no longer retries without a language the server rejected
fix(ci): an e2e job waits up to 2 h for a free slot before failing closed

entries.detail: Lays the foundation for voice input and output against OpenAI-compatible speech servers, including a compatibility check and design notes; no user-facing voice features yet.
entries.title: Voice groundwork: speech server contract and compatibility checks

entries.detail: The install action now completes straight away instead of waiting for a trust confirmation that bundled entries never show.
entries.title: Installing a bundled agent from the catalog no longer gets stuck
test(voice): match the personas' accent rule case-insensitively (main red after )

entries.detail: Register a server, resolve its credentials per project, verify it with a handshake and tool listing, then launch it from any CLI; output is withheld entirely if it leaks a credential.
entries.title: Run third-party MCP servers in your projects, with credential-safe checks

entries.detail: The bundled 0.20 release notes are gone, so the Help menu, tour footer, About page and Updates card no longer offer them; the dialog stays ready for generated notes.
entries.title: Out-of-date What's new notes are no longer shown

entries.detail: When the link is down, API conversations display establishing, re-establishing and restored states, and queued messages wait for a good read before sending.
entries.title: API sessions now show the same connection status veil as terminal sessions

entries.detail: When a model puts a tool call in plain text, BattleLab now asks it again once and never saves that text as the final answer.
entries.title: Tool calls written as text are retried instead of being stored as the answer

entries.detail: Cold scans across all providers dropped from about 70 seconds to about 9, and the discovery rows are unchanged for every real API session.
entries.title: API session discovery is much faster, reading only the start of each journal

entries.detail: The broker socket is now made private directly, so files and folders created around startup keep their normal permissions and no longer fail with permission errors.
entries.title: Secrets broker no longer alters permissions of unrelated files at startup

entries.detail: The Chevron Plate mark and wordmark now appear consistently in the top bar, sign-in pages, favicons, app icons and shared views, all drawn from a single brand source.
entries.title: New BattleLab logo across the app, docs and landing pages

entries.detail: Replies now appear as they arrive with a gentle fade, new rows animate in, scrolling follows new output smoothly, and Jump to latest counts only new rows; reduced motion keeps fades but makes follow instant.
entries.title: Live sessions stream replies more smoothly and follow new output

entries.detail: When an upload started through the public API was cancelled from outside, it kept holding its slot; it now releases it so other uploads can go ahead.
entries.title: Cancelled public uploads now free their upload slot again
Internal change

entries.detail: Send text into any session even while the agent is busy, and optionally stop the current turn first; queued messages never answer pending approvals or questions.
entries.title: HQ can message any agent session, working or idle, and interrupt a running turn

entries.detail: The operator is now addressed as Commander only occasionally, so replies and spoken call lines read more naturally.
entries.title: HQ replies and voice calls no longer say Commander in every line

entries.detail: Related sessions are automatically grouped into clusters, and the session list and API now include cluster information so you can see which sessions belong together.
entries.title: Sessions can now be grouped into clusters and shown in the session list

entries.detail: Sessions no longer end on a 24-hour timer or while background processes run; cut-off work is recorded, and Stop asks before ending running tasks.
entries.title: API sessions stay alive until background work is idle
test(web): the noise gate's seed sweeps get a 30 s budget on a loaded runner

entries.detail: After a sign-in ends, the terminal stays on the last screen with a status note, links open on click or tap, and a one-line field sends a pasted code so you can finish from a phone.
entries.title: Agent sign-in now keeps the vendor's last screen and opens its links

entries.detail: Verification loads a pinned probe's transcript by its identifier, and a check that stops now tells you why instead of failing without a reason.
entries.title: Plugin verification now reads the pinned probe transcript and explains stopped checks

entries.detail: A new GitHub connector lets HQ read commit statuses, workflow runs and check runs, and reports rate limits or missing permissions instead of quietly showing a green result.
entries.title: Connect GitHub repositories to see commit statuses, Actions runs and check results

entries.detail: Turn-taking now offers Quick, Natural and Patient pauses, so HQ waits longer before replying when you need time to finish speaking.
entries.title: Voice calls no longer cut you off mid-thought

entries.detail: HQ's own notifications now sit with the events they cover in a single Notifications view, and the separate in-page strip on HQ's views is gone.
entries.title: Notifications now appear in one place, alongside the events they cover

entries.detail: Summary tiles, needs-you rows and the HQ card no longer squeeze or wrap on portrait tablets and small phones.
entries.title: Dashboard now fits tablets and phones without cramped, wrapping tiles

entries.detail: The card shows each step the approval covers, and approvals pinned under the old definition are refused and must be re-approved; running missions continue on your own starts.
entries.title: Rework approval card now lists the exact span before you approve

entries.detail: Dead code paths and stale settings that nothing used are gone; the behaviour you rely on is unchanged.
entries.title: Removed unused Pulse session scanning and legacy orchestrator settings

entries.detail: Opening the session list no longer re-reads the alias data for every row, so pages with many sessions respond noticeably faster.
entries.title: Session list loads faster by reading engine aliases once per request

entries.detail: Six bundled agents now point at newer upstream versions that have been public for at least 72 hours; nothing about how agents launch has changed.
entries.title: Bundled agent catalog refreshed to the latest stable releases
test(terminal): the paste-intake fake agent replaces its log atomically
test(app): the share-masking CPU bound has headroom for the loaded shared runner

entries.detail: Background noise and stock no-speech phrases no longer create HQ turns, trigger language drift, or cancel an armed confirmation.

entries.title: Removed the misleading attach note under API-session composers

entries.detail: When a turn fails because the login expired, the Sign in button now takes you straight to connecting your account instead of a verification or enable screen.
entries.title: Sign in from a failed turn now opens the sign-in step

entries.title: Start a new session from a specialist, with its agent, model and effort preset

entries.title: Store secret files in Variables and let agents read them

entries.detail: Session headers no longer carry a separate copy-link button, so sharing a session goes through Share publicly, which works exactly as before.
entries.title: One-tap Share link removed; Share publicly is now the only share option

entries.detail: While HQ works on a call it can say brief, natural asides instead of only fixed status lines, and anything sensitive is removed before it is spoken.
entries.title: HQ now thinks out loud with short asides during calls

entries.title: Connect Nextcloud files so HQ can browse, search and read them

entries.title: Call HQ lets you talk to your AI agent by voice and hear its answer

entries.detail: Pick Telegram, Matrix or SMTP, choose an allowed recipient when saving, and send fixed text or a template; sending stays rate-limited and needs re-approval if the messenger changes.
entries.title: Automations can now send a message through a messenger you set up

entries.detail: Reading federated sessions keeps working while a presence update is throttled or a busy dialer is quiet, instead of waiting on it.
entries.title: Federation reads no longer stall behind a slow liveness update

entries.detail: Send a signed POST of typed fields to an HTTPS destination you choose, with private addresses blocked, redirects refused, and fixed values checked against stored secrets.
entries.title: Automations can call a webhook with typed fields

entries.detail: Later runs add revisions while it stays private; once you share it publicly, the next run starts a new private artifact so the public link never changes silently.
entries.title: Automations can publish a project file or folder as a private artifact

entries.detail: The fourth and final action type: agents can file a note into project memory, with the same review step and safety checks as the other actions.
entries.title: Automations can now write a reviewed memory note into a project's memory

entries.detail: If another connection keeps the source locked, the backup now gives up after a bounded wait, removes the partial copy, and retries on the next access instead of stalling migration indefinitely.
entries.title: Cold migration no longer hangs forever when the federation database is busy

entries.detail: A refused code now follows the normal failed-login path and counts toward the existing lockout, so bad input no longer triggers an internal error.
entries.title: Non-ASCII authenticator codes are rejected as invalid instead of causing a server error

entries.detail: If the conversation changes while an agent is streaming, your send is retried a few times with short waits, so it can land instead of immediately returning a retry error.
entries.title: Sending a message during a streaming turn now retries instead of failing

entries.detail: Navigation targets were audited, and the patched router now rejects unsafe redirect targets, so nothing changes in how you use the app.
entries.title: Upgraded the routing library to close an open-redirect security gap

entries.detail: The new-session form now has a single agent picker with a mode switch, so you decide how the agent runs before launching, and API mode is preselected.
entries.title: Choose Terminal or API mode when starting a session, API by default
fix(web): drive useMissionDetail value tests on a manual clock

entries.detail: Every way an agent gets started now hands it a cleaned-up environment, so its own secret key, password hash and push keys stay private while vendor credentials and normal shell settings still work.
entries.title: Agents no longer see BattleLab's own secrets in their environment

entries.detail: When a report answer is refused, tapping the option now returns the normal refusal response instead of a server error, and no text is typed.
entries.title: Report answer refusals no longer return a server error

entries.detail: Garbage or truncated upload bodies are rejected as bad requests instead of returning a server error or publishing a partial file.
entries.title: Malformed multipart uploads now fail with a clear 400 and leave no partial file

entries.detail: The commit is applied once the draft becomes active, discarded drafts never commit, and cancelling before the first step no longer leaves the call stuck.
entries.title: Muting a voice draft before it is ready no longer loses the commit

entries.detail: A runtime-only run no longer claims the local speech server is ready; it tells you to configure speech endpoints in settings before calling.
entries.title: Runtime-only voice setup now ends with accurate next steps

entries.detail: When a gallery copy's update listing is malformed, its detail now shows the usual can't-check-for-updates message instead of crashing.
entries.title: Gallery copy details no longer crash on a malformed update listing
fix(tests): handshake the mission write-fence dispatch instead of a wall clock

entries.detail: Sessions, HQ and Missions are introduced step by step, and the new blog has searchable posts, tag pages and a feed; a failed deploy leaves the previous release live.
entries.title: New landing page explains BattleLab in three layers, plus a blog
fix(tests): use a never-live PID for stale-lock fixtures

entries.detail: Mission nudges, automation follow-ups and dispatch briefs now fail cleanly when no worker is running instead of silently launching a new one; manual sends still resume as before.
entries.title: Automatic agent sends no longer restart a stopped API worker

entries.detail: Queued or cut lines no longer show up in the minimised bar, so the text you see matches what was really said.
entries.title: On-call bar now quotes only the caption that was actually spoken

entries.detail: If you drop an objective and add a new one under the same name while the agent is paused, it is now raised again instead of staying quiet; older pending raises still match by name alone.
entries.title: Re-added objectives are raised again while an agent is still stopped
test(federation): serialise the list-race helper's read-then-change, so overlapping…
fix(tests): keep the isolation tripwire's probes in tmp and follow symlinks

entries.detail: A stuck test fails the run with a stack dump after three minutes, and a retry can no longer turn a real hang into a pass.
entries.title: Hung tests now time out instead of stalling the validation pipeline
fix(ci): appmode e2e reaps its own dtach masters and pins the agent fixture

entries.detail: Two new automation steps run a command or a script directly, with arguments passed as-is and no shell involved, so nothing gets reinterpreted along the way.
entries.title: Automations can now run a command or a script, contained and without a shell

entries.detail: Input held during teardown now reaches the terminal instead of being written to a closed handle, so keystrokes are not silently dropped.
entries.title: Web terminal input is no longer lost when a session is torn down

entries.detail: BattleLab blocks these commands before they reach an older worker, while bypass sessions and ordinary commands keep working as before.
entries.title: Guarded opencode subtask slash commands are now refused with a clear reason

entries.detail: After the server takes over a placeholder terminal, reconnecting now picks up the existing session rather than starting a fresh agent launch.
entries.title: Reconnecting an adopted terminal resumes its session instead of launching a new one

entries.detail: When a session's socket path exceeds the operating system limit, the terminal shows a clear non-retryable error with the measured length and limit instead of looping on busy reconnects.
entries.title: Terminal now reports an over-long socket path instead of retrying forever

entries.detail: Opening Artifacts from the mission menu no longer leaves the page interactive behind the dialog, so keyboard and screen-reader users stay focused inside it.
entries.title: Artifacts dialog now opens correctly from the mission menu

entries.detail: A nudge is refused if the objective was dropped, re-created, or replaced by a new episode, so guidance can no longer land on the wrong objective.
entries.title: Supervisor nudges now stay tied to the objective the model actually read

entries.detail: BattleLab now rejects manifests that declare a writable store as read-only, and the bundled writer plugins have been corrected.
entries.title: Writer plugins can no longer be marked read-only by mistake

entries.detail: If an automation was saved after its edit draft was read, the card is refused as stale and must be re-read, so outdated changes are not applied.
entries.title: Automation edit cards now reject stale drafts instead of overwriting newer changes

entries.detail: Session lookups no longer add unrelated session rows to answers, and when a turn includes steps the question now appears below them, just above the composer.
entries.title: HQ shows only requested sessions and puts questions after steps

entries.detail: Session cards and voice read-backs name the session kind, and the default agent is chosen without asking; terminal sessions start only when you request one.
entries.title: HQ now starts API sessions by default and uses a terminal only when asked

entries.detail: New sessions launch the newer upstream releases; no launch options or settings changed.
entries.title: Bundled agent catalog updated to newer Claude, Codex, Gemini and Kimi versions
docs(operating-model): session assistance on Act on its own may nudge a terminal patrol…

entries.detail: Published cuts that leave out the read-only flag are now served with their real value instead of being rejected, so upgraded hosts keep their catalog and can still install agents.
entries.title: Signed agent catalog cuts are accepted again, so agents stay installable

entries.detail: The pressed state uses the body text colour on every accent preset in both themes, and hovering or focusing no longer changes the contrast.
entries.title: Pressed chips now keep readable text on their tinted background
test(web): two-server browser journeys for federation view, suggest/send and working…

entries.detail: Reviews triggered by a CI-relayed push to a pull request were being ignored; they now start the same review as a direct push.
entries.title: A push relayed by CI now starts a review as expected

entries.detail: A short spoken thinking cue plays almost immediately, answers use a more conversational register, and asides arrive sooner; very short asides are skipped from audio but still count for reactions.
entries.title: HQ now sounds more natural on calls, with quicker asides and a thinking cue

entries.detail: Subagent runs appear as a collapsible group beneath the session that spawned them, keeping the sidebar tidy while still letting you open each one.
entries.title: Subagent sessions now nest under their main session in the sidebar

entries.detail: API targets no longer fail as unavailable or create a conversation without a session; continuing from here opens the agent's session as expected.
entries.title: Continue here now starts sessions for API agents

entries.detail: Read-backs end with a single natural question, choices are offered as "this or that", and screen references sound less robotic.
entries.title: Voice calls now ask like a person, with one plain question at a time

entries.detail: The active account is highlighted, and quota alerts now name the window that ran out, so you can tell which limit was hit.
entries.title: Dashboard shows usage windows for every agent account, with clearer alerts

entries.detail: Artifacts can now be stored in shared repositories with storage accounting and publishing, managed from a new Library tab and an operator API.
entries.title: Share artifact repositories across agents on one instance
docs(voice): a connector message on a call asks for its phrase, not a bare yes
